title: Build Your Own macOS Kernel — Results
title_zh: 编译自己的 macOS 内核——成果篇
text: Background macOS is an excellent operating system, yet many iOS and macOS developers only encounter operating-system internals in documentation. Working directly with the macOS kernel source is difficult and demanding. After a long investigation, I completed that journey and built a macOS system with my own startup program and kernel.
